properties.name: Install
properties.purpose:
Getting reflow2 INTO somebody else's project: asking which harness, writing only that harness's files, and leaving a committable record.

⚠️ A SUBSYSTEM OF ONE, AND KEPT THAT WAY DELIBERATELY. It is the only part of this system that WRITES INTO A REPOSITORY THAT IS NOT REFLOW2'S OWN — every other part reads a design or answers a call. Folding it into a larger box to avoid a group of one would hide the single place where the blast radius leaves this project, which is exactly the boundary `rule:reflow2-is-built-for-other-projects-not-for-itself` cares about.

Group size is a check on whether a grouping is doing work, not a quota to fill.
